jobs.description:
Our client is a recognised player in real estate advisory, specialising in supporting investors and corporates with strategic property transactions. With a solid reputation and deep market expertise, the company combines local market knowledge with a forward-looking investment approach, delivering tailored solutions across multiple asset classes.

Jobomschrijving

• Identify and originate new investment opportunities in the real estate market
• Build and manage a portfolio of investors and key stakeholders
• Develop financial models and investment cases for complex transactions
• Conduct market research, trend analysis, and due diligence
• Advise clients on transaction structuring and investment strategies
• Prepare high-quality presentations and investment memoranda
• Collaborate with internal teams to execute deals end-to-end
• Contribute to the growth and positioning of the business unit

• Relevant experience in finance, banking, real estate or investment advisory (3 to 8 years)
• Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities
• Commercial mindset with a track record of business development or deal-making
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Ability to build relationships with senior-level stakeholders
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-driven personality
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Bilingual Dutch and French, English is an asset

• Our client is a well-established Belgian industrial SME operating in the electrical equipment and energy infrastructure sector, delivering innovative solutions for power distribution and electrical installations.
• Combining the agility of a local entrepreneur-driven organization with an international business exposure, the company serves utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across Belgium and European markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for Medium Voltage and electrical distribution solutions in Belgium and BENELUX.
• Identify new business opportunities and build long-term relationships with key stakeholders including utilities, electrical contractors, engineering firms, panel builders, and industrial customers.
• Promote and develop the portfolio of Medium Voltage equipment and power distribution solutions.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor, supporting customers in product selection, applications, and industry requirements.
• Monitor market developments, industry trends, and competitive activities to identify growth opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Management teams to drive business performance and support future business unit development.

• Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in technical sales, business development, or BU management (P&L management) within the electrical distribution sector.
• Strong knowledge of Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, power distribution equipment, switchgear, MCCBs, RMUs, DSO or related electrical solutions.
• Commercially driven with the ability to build relationships and develop new business opportunities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a professional command of English.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

About this job
Are you comfortable taking the lead in a production environment? Do you enjoy combining people management with a strong focus on quality and efficiency? For a growing company, we are looking for a Packaging Team Leader to strengthen the operations team.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

Production Logistics Associate, Day Shift

Are you looking for a full-time day-shift job in a production environment in the Tielt area? In this role, you’ll support the flow of goods involved in manufacturing windows and doors.
A metalworking production environment
You’ll join a workplace where metal windows and doors are made.
What you’ll do
• 
Receive, inspect, and store goods and materials.

• 
Load windows and doors onto racks and gather materials for production.

• 
Move windows, doors, and components within the facility, and help with loading and unloading.

• 
Inspect finished products and prepare them for shipping.

• 
Keep the warehouse and work areas organized, track the flow of goods, and step in where needed.

Do you thrive when you can roll up your sleeves and work alongside colleagues to get things done? Then you may recognize yourself in this profile.

• 
You’re someone who sees what needs to be done and likes to pitch in.

• 
You’re comfortable with physical work, and it doesn’t hold you back from staying active.

• 
You approach your work with accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Your positive attitude helps you contribute to a great team environment.

You have a good command of Dutch or English.

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Senior Accountant at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Senior Accountant plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Senior Account we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics or business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and pay attention to detail? We are looking for an assembly worker for a production company in Lokeren that assembles car seats for Volvo Trucks. Experience in assembly or production is important, as well as accuracy, concentration and a practical attitude.
 

As a car seat assembly worker, you will work on a production line where car seats are assembled. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure that every component is fitted correctly and that the finished product meets the required quality standards.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

•  

Assemble car seat components on the production line.
  

•  

Carry out your part of the assembly process accurately.
  

•  

Check your work and make sure all components are assembled correctly.
  

•  

Regularly change workstations and help out at different stages of the production process.
  
 

•  

You have experience as an assembly worker or in a similar production role.
  

•  

You are physically fit and comfortable handling heavier components.
  

•  

You work accurately, stay focused and pay attention to quality.
  

•  

You have a good command of spoken and written English.

As a Customer Support Assistant, you will be responsible for delivering a smooth and professional customer experience from the first contact through to order delivery.
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for distributors and end users, handling questions, requests and issues in a professional and customer-oriented way. 

• Manage the complete order process, from order intake through logistics, including coordinating shipments and transport. 

• Provide high-quality customer support via phone, email and chat. 

• Follow up on customer requests and issues and ensure timely and effective resolution. 

• Keep customer information, interactions and issues accurately recorded in our CRM system. 

• Identify recurring customer issues and share insights with internal teams to help improve our products and services. 

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve our customer service processes and contribute to initiatives that make our way of working more efficient. 

• Work closely with colleagues across different teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. 

You are a customer-oriented and solution-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and working in a fast-paced environment.
 

You bring:
 
 

• Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken - this is essential. 

• A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. 

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. 

• A structured and accurate way of working, with a strong eye for detail. 

• The ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of service. 

• A proactive, positive and customer-centric mindset. 

• Previous experience in customer support, order administration or a similar role is a plus. 

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.

MuleSoft certification

• You will perform detailed finishing work to ensure professional, durable results

• You will complete 25-30 square meters per day while maintaining quality standards

• You will follow all technical specifications and safety regulations

• You will work independently and collaboratively with our multilingual team

• You will ensure all work meets durability and aesthetic requirements

• You have at least 5 years of professional experience as a tiler

• You possess expertise in both interior and exterior tiling techniques

• You demonstrate excellent finishing skills and meticulous attention to detail

• You can work independently with precision and reliability

• You are motivated, reliable, and committed to quality workmanship

• You will make diagnoses using STAR and MANCATS diagnostic systems

• You will carry out maintenance orders on trucks

• You will dismantle and remove components as needed

• You will perform custom work for specific customer orders

Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

Job description 

    
• No experience in car transport required (CE licence experience is essential)
    
• Working week: Mon–Fri (full-time; longer hours possible but not compulsory)
    
• You may take the lorry home – can leave from your place of residence
    
• Language: German or English (minimum)
    
• Candidates may live in Belgium (German payroll)

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.
